draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.66, the 252nd-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 16th of 18 at guard. He went 195th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (252nd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%.

Versus the typical Year-1 guard who played: 2.2% season snap share against a median of 29.9%, below the norm.
